_doc: MoE strategy registry. moe_loop reads it → runs one version for each enabled strategy → the gate selects the best. All strategies first read the shared brain CRAFT.md(general rules+position+concern tactics+wording),then layer on this strategy's posture. Add/merge a strategy = place a strategies/<id>.md(referencing CRAFT)+ register it here. Engine-agnostic.
_presentation_doc: Primary external-facing presentation method(argument compilation):CRAFT is the internal logic(think through exactly what to answer),write-direct-rebuttals governs how the final reviewer-facing draft is written(literal direct answer for each slot/verbatim numbering/no pleasantries/three-way tense distinction/deletion+ammunition). ground truth comes from manual edits in lyzHandCraft.

route._doc: Strategy ladder(③ routing + ④ cost optimization,merged into the same problem). reviewer_loop writes the first strategy in this order → stops as soon as it clears the gate;writes the next only if it does not. The gain comes from 'writing less',not from 'choosing correctly'. Based on empirical measurements in campaigns/01-wdData/ledger/cost.jsonl:writer 447k in/run vs judge 16k in/run(writer accounts for 94% of the token);9/9 all clear the zone bar(criterion saturation,quality cannot distinguish them);costs across strategies differ by only 8%(cost cannot distinguish them either). Therefore,do not pretend we can choose the best;use only a defensible default order.
route._ladder_why: s1 declares itself in this MANIFEST as risk=low(low-risk anchor)→ the default first choice;s2(high raise potential)next;s3(weak-draft turnaround)as fallback. This order is derived from the **posture declaration**,not the empirically measured optimum —— current measurements cannot distinguish them.
route._by_zone_why: Intentionally left empty:9/9 all pass,so no evidence supports differentiated ordering by reviewer zone;do not fabricate. Populating it requires evidence that 'within the same zone,a certain strategy has a significantly higher gate-clearance rate',which requires first making the gate discriminative(currently saturated).
